description: Explain a council penalty charge notice contravention code (the two-digit code on the PCN, with any suffix letter): what it means, whether it is a higher or lower level contravention, what any suffix means, and the grounds the law allows for formal representations in England. No amounts: those depend on the council and are printed on the notice. Private parking charges do not use these codes.

code.description: The code as printed, e.g. "01", "12r" or "31J".

name: explain_contravention_code
title: Explain a council PCN code
